samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyfrac">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by fractional values. It generates a clock signal with a fractional frequency division (3.5x), using the double-edge clocking technique to achieve half-integer division while adjusting for duty cycle imbalance. By dividing uneven clock cycles and phase-shifting them, a smooth fractional clock output is produced.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal to initialize the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Fractionally divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="MUL2_DIV_CLK">7</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of clock cycles.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div_int">Intermediate divided clock signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_delay">Delayed phase signal.</reg>
        <reg id="phase_advance">Advanced phase signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Counter to keep track of clock cycles
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == MUL2_DIV_CLK - 1) begin
                    cnt <= 0;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Generate intermediate divided clock signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                clk_div_int <= 0;
            end else begin
                if ((cnt >= 0 && cnt <= 3) || (cnt >= 5 && cnt <= 6)) begin
                    clk_div_int <= ~clk_div_int;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Phase delay and advance generation
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                phase_delay <= 0;
                phase_advance <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt == 4) begin
                    phase_delay <= clk_div_int;
                end
                
                if (cnt == 3) begin
                    phase_advance <= clk_div_int;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Final fractional divided clock output
        assign clk_div = clk_div_int | phase_delay | phase_advance;
    </implementation>
</module>
